organisms.safety_summary: Important EFSA genotoxicity concern for a studied root extract; avoid presenting commercial products as proven safe. Pregnancy and hormone-sensitive conditions warrant caution.
organisms.evidence_summary: A 2021 randomized trial investigated standardized root extract and testosterone-related outcomes in aging men; results were formulation-specific and included manufacturer employees. A 2021 EFSA assessment found potential DNA damage from a tested root extract and concluded safety had not been established.
